# Nyan

Nyan applies a pixel-retro Nyan Cat look with rainbow headings, gradient horizontal rules, pop-tart checkboxes and pixel-art file icons. It adds a bouncing pixel Nyan Cat in the status bar, a twinkling starfield in dark mode, a rainbow loading bar, chunky square-corner UI and silkscreen pixel fonts.

![Nyan screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kubixservice/obsidian-nyan-theme/HEAD/screenshot-dark.png)

```cue

    name:   "Nyan"
    author: "kubixservice"
```
